info.name: IRoad Mobile Driver — Home Dashboard Module
info.description:
# IRoad Mobile — Home Dashboard Module

Production-ready collection for driver home dashboard APIs.

## Prerequisites
1. Import **IRoad Mobile Driver Dashboard — Local** environment.
2. Set `base_url`, `email`, `password`.
3. Run **Setup → Login** (saves `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `driver_id`).
4. Run **Testing Flow → Full Dashboard Smoke** (folder runner) or individual requests.

## Auth & tenant
| Item | Rule |
|------|------|
| **Authorization** | `Bearer {{access_token}}` — required on all dashboard routes |
| **Tenant** | Resolved from JWT `tenant_schema` — **no X-Tenant-ID required** |
| **X-Tenant-ID** | Optional; if sent, must match JWT tenant (else **403** `tenant_mismatch`) |
| **Capability** | `mobile.driver.dashboard` (driver principal + `driver_id` claim) |

## Envelope
```json
{ "status": 1, "message": "…", "data": { }, "meta": { } }
```
- `status` **1** = success, **0** = business/validation, **2** = auth (**401**/**403**)

## API map
| Request | Method | Path | Dedicated endpoint? |
|---------|--------|------|-------------------|
| Dashboard (full) | GET | `/driver/dashboard/` | Yes — includes `current_job`, `quick_actions` |
| Dashboard summary | GET | `/driver/dashboard/summary/` | Yes |
| Recent activity | GET | `/driver/dashboard/recent-activity/` | Yes |
| Notifications summary | GET | `/driver/dashboard/notifications-summary/` | Yes |
| Current job | — | — | **Embedded** in full/summary dashboard (`data.current_job`) |
| Quick actions | — | — | **Embedded** in full/summary dashboard (`data.quick_actions`) |

Use **Extract Current Job** / **Extract Quick Actions** requests to validate embedded sections and save env vars.

## Docs
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_dashboard.md`
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_dashboard_security.md`
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_dashboard_performance.md`

request.description:
**Method:** POST

**Auth:** None

**Tenant header:** Not used on login.

Saves `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `driver_id` to environment.
Rotate tokens after login. Optional body `tenant_id` must match refresh JWT if sent.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Method** | GET |
| **URL** | `{{base_url}}/api/v1/mobile/driver/dashboard/` |
| **Auth** | Bearer `{{access_token}}` |
| **X-Tenant-ID** | Optional (must match JWT) |
| **Body** | None |

Returns full dashboard: `welcome`, `driver_summary`, `counters`, **`current_job`**, **`quick_actions`**, `notifications_summary`, `recent_activity` (max 10), `timestamps`.
